🌎 Explore 7 Different Difficulties!
👆 Select any Stage!
🔒 Unlock Difficulties!
💪 Become a Wall Hop Pro!

Wall Hop Frenzy is like a Difficulty Chart Obby, only you can select your stages within your difficulty. If you are stuck you can come back. If you are a skilled wall hop player you can try the harder stages in the game!

👍 We have tons of feedback saying this game has helped players become a pro wall hopper!

Please ⭐/👍 to help support the game!
